artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan adding an out-of-scope refusal guard to git-snapshot.sh's reverting modes, a canonical path-containment predicate, a fixture regression test, task-identified stash messages, and four documentation guardrails.

memory_candidates.content: This repo already centralizes path/scope matching in scripts/lib/file-scope-overlap.sh, governed by context/patterns/file-footprint-overlap.md, which declares itself the single source of truth and explicitly excludes glob/regex matching. But it answers only the SYMMETRIC task-vs-task overlap question (either side a directory-prefix ancestor of the other). A one-directional CONTAINMENT question -- 'is this one concrete dirty path covered by a declared file_scope?' -- is a distinct predicate. When a new consumer needs containment, add a sibling function to that lib plus a subsection to the governing doc rather than writing a private fourth copy of path matching; and note that ~1% of live file_scope entries are globs (e.g. 'agent-system/extensions/*/agents/**'), which the canonical prefix rule silently fails to match.
